thread:
DesignLead: Heads-up: a few enterprise customers reported confusing breadcrumbs after the left-rail regroup. They land via SSO links and see Workspace > Environments > Deployments instead of the new Cluster > Deployments context. We need a plan that covers SSO redirects, i18n label fallbacks, and shareable permalinks. Thoughts?
PM_Carmen: key constraint: SSO URL flows sometimes add query params like `?source=idp`. We must ensure deep links survive that and still end up with the correct canonical path. Also legal wants the share dialog to show the canonical URL (no temp params).
FrontEndSam: on SSO: we already strip auth params after handshake, but we can normalize the path during post-login redirect. Implementation: on auth callback, run a small router-normalize step that maps legacy/sloppy paths to canonical cluster-aware paths before hydration.
RouterOlivia: agree. prefer server-side normalization where possible to avoid race conditions. sketching a manifest for alias handling (pseudo JSON):
```
{
  "aliases": [
    {"from": "/w/:wid/infra/deploy", "to": "/workspaces/:wid/deployments"},
    {"from": "/w/:wid/old-models", "to": "/workspaces/:wid/models/catalog"}
  ],
  "strip_query_on_redirect": ["source","idp","utm_*"]
}
```
We can apply these at edge (CDN) or in the app server. Edge gives fewer client hops.
A11y_Jai: accessibility note: when breadcrumbs change shape, screen reader users expect consistent announcements. If we insert cluster as a new crumb, use `aria-current` on the final crumb and ensure `aria-label` on the breadcrumb container describes the navigation context (e.g., "Breadcrumb: Deployments in Workspace Alpha"). Also consider a hidden helper that reads "cluster: Deployments" on navigation to orient users.
UX_Marta: did a microtest with international users — label length matters. In Spanish the cluster label becomes long and pushes the page title off-screen on small widths. Recommendation: short primary label + secondary long label in tooltip. e.g., visible: "Despliegues" shortened to "Deploys" in narrow view, tooltip: "Despliegues (Deployments)".
DesignLead: good catch. We also need to avoid slug collisions: some model ids look like `catalog` and could be mistaken for cluster slugs. Olivia, what about canonicalizing path segments to avoid collision?
RouterOlivia: two options: 1) reserve certain path prefixes (clusters) and forbid resource ids colliding at the same level, 2) add explicit cluster prefix like `/cluster/deployments` to disambiguate. We prefer reserving prefixes + validation at model onboarding time to avoid breaking existing links. We'll add a server-side check that rejects model names equal to reserved clusters.
FrontEndSam: for share dialog canonicalization: when users click Share, we'll compute canonicalHref by stripping UI-only params and mapping any alias to canonical path via the same manifest. Show that canonicalHref in the dialog and copy that to clipboard. Also add a small "Preview canonical" link so users can confirm it goes to the expected breadcrumb.
PM_Carmen: metrics: add an event `nav_alias_resolved` with originalPath + canonicalPath (hashed for PII) and a rollout flag `nav_v2`. Retain raw original paths for 14 days then discard. Legal okayed short retention for debugging.
DevBot: created ticket RDW-4010: "Edge alias manifest + SSO redirect normalization" and subtask RDW-4010a: "Share dialog canonical URL + preview".
DesignLead: UX question: do we show cluster landing pages? e.g., clicking 'Deployments' goes to /workspaces/:id/deployments (landing) with list; breadcrumbs then read Workspace > Deployments > <resource>. This helps users reorient. Agree?
UX_Marta: yes. Landing pages also help analytics and can host quick actions. For mobile, prefer collapsible first-level clusters and keep landing pages shallow.
A11y_Jai: keyboard access: add a skip link target at the top of each cluster landing page ("Skip to deployments list") and expose `g` then `d` global shortcut to jump to cluster landing. Make shortcuts configurable and discoverable in the help modal.
FrontEndSam: implementation note: we'll add client-side rewrite logic fallback for older browsers; edge rewrite is primary. Also will include a small migration banner on first visit to a user (cookie) explaining nav changes and linking to a short doc. Banner copy options to A/B: 1) "Sidebar reorganized — find Deployments under Deployments." 2) "We've grouped related pages for quicker access. Learn what's changed."
PM_Carmen: prefer option 2 for tone. DevOps ask: ensure feature flag so we can rollback per customer workspace.
RouterOlivia: final: will prepare alias manifest RFC and a list of reserved prefixes. Expect PR by EOD Friday.
DesignLead: perfect. Sam, Olivia, Jai, UX Marta — follow-ups: implement the manifest + share preview, a11y checks, i18n label fallbacks, and migration banner A/B. We'll track RDW-4010. Thanks all :sparkles:
